durations: Madame's piano played for 13 minutes, from 10:48 to 11:01 by the kitchen clock
whereabouts: Rosa said the glasses for the toast were on the kitchen table and that she dried them herself in the kitchen.
Madame's champagne was in the cold box with the ice.
Fräulein Lina came down into the kitchen at 10:37 by the kitchen clock.
Fräulein Lina stayed with Rosa in the kitchen until after the temple struck eleven.
Madame was playing the piano (Chopin) from 10:48 to 11:01 by the kitchen clock.
Rosa and Lina heard the piano from the kitchen.
When the piano stopped, Rosa was in the kitchen, where it was very quiet.
Rosa went up the stairs to the atelier to fetch the master for the toast.
Rosa opened the door of the atelier and found the master on the floor.
The master was lying upstairs, on the floor of the atelier, when Rosa found him.
Rosa is sitting in the dining room with the police at the time of the interview.
